name: ES One-Position First-Signal Challenger v1
instrument: MES execution using the three frozen ES signal engines
signal_changes: none; every component retains its frozen signal, stop, and exit

portfolio_rule.selection: take the earliest valid component entry of the session
portfolio_rule.same_minute_tie_breaker: take the signal with the smaller frozen initial structural risk in USD; break an exact risk tie by engine name
portfolio_rule.later_signals: ignore every later signal that session even if the selected trade stops

rationale: Reduce concurrent structural risk, eliminate stacked execution, and avoid choosing engines by historical profitability. Time priority and lower-risk tie breaking are observable at the decision time and do not use future P&L.

historical_diagnostic.diagnostic_verdict: The rule materially reduces concurrent exposure and drawdown-tail estimates while retaining the requested frequency. It does not improve evidence quality: it remains negative under a $2.50 per-trade reserve, more dependent on its five best trades, and has a higher bootstrap probability of nonpositive total P&L. Preserve only as a prospective paper challenger.

prospective_approval_gates.maximum_drawdown: must remain inside an account-level dollar risk limit chosen before paper trading

prohibited_changes: engine priority based on historical P&L
side, weekday, volatility, agreement, or regime filters
taking a later signal after the selected trade stops
changing component signals, stops, or exits
changing the tie breaker after historical comparison
